instruction: Save the audio from this music video as a WAV file named "Baby Justin Bieber.wav" on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened terminal, listed desktop files to find the MP4, then used ffmpeg to convert 'Baby Justin Bieber.mp4' to MP3 with libmp3lame codec. Verified the output file (4.8MB) existed on the desktop. Completed in 8 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open terminal, use ffmpeg for media conversion with codec flags, handle file paths with spaces, verify file creation with ls
metadata.task_rationale: Tests same audio extraction capability but with a different output format (WAV instead of MP3), requiring knowledge of ffmpeg WAV output options
metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting audio from the desktop MP4 video and saving as WAV format. Custom getter runs ffprobe on the VM to check file properties. Metric verifies: file exists (0.3), audio-only no video (0.3), WAV format/codec (0.2), reasonable duration ~219s (0.2).

scoring_breakdown.file_exists: 0.3 - Output WAV file exists at expected path
scoring_breakdown.audio_only: 0.3 - File contains audio stream without video
scoring_breakdown.correct_format: 0.2 - File is in WAV format with PCM codec

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly checks file at /home/user/Desktop/Baby Justin Bieber.wav using ffprobe, extracting format, codec, streams, and duration — all relevant properties for verifying WAV audio extraction.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter: accesses expected.get('expected_formats') etc. directly on the rules dict, which is correct for expected.type='rule'.
All instruction requirements are verified: file existence (0.3), audio-only content without video streams (0.3), WAV format/PCM codec (0.2), and reasonable duration matching source video ~219s (0.2).
Partial credit logic is sensible: gives 0.15 for audio with video (file converted but not stripped), and graceful 0.3 for parse errors (file exists but unreadable).
Expected values are appropriate: WAV format, standard PCM codecs (pcm_s16le/s24le/s32le/f32le), duration range 100-300s covers the ~219s source video.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: format check uses substring match (any(f in actual_format ...)) which could theoretically match unintended formats, but 'wav' is unlikely to appear as substring in other format names, so this is low risk.
